digest.component_or_area: transition + claim commands (lib / CLI / internal guidance)
propositions: transition library signature diverges from claim: transition(force: bool, reason, force_close) splits the force-bypass concept across multiple parameters while claim(force: str|None) unifies it; this must be harmonized to match claim's canonical shape.
The transition CLI permits --reason to serve as the force-bypass audit note, a coupling claim does not have; the force-bypass reason must ride exclusively on --force[=<reason>] across both commands.

The in-memory spelling of the force-bypass reason is inconsistent across transition and claim: force_reason, force_close, force_close_reason, and force_plan_review are used interchangeably; this must unify to force_reason internally while preserving the persisted status_data["force_close_reason"] key.
Legacy code calling transition(force_close=<r>) or transition(force=True) must be migrated to the new force: str|None signature via deprecation aliases with warnings.

Every guidance string and help text (gates.py override hint, txn.py override hints, transition.py usage) currently shows multiple spellings (--force --reason, --force=<reason>, or decoupled patterns); all must converge to the single approved --force[=<reason>] pattern.
